_note: The capability model (Phase 7; spec SURVIVAL_HOMESTEAD_WORLD_CAPABILITY §3-4, MASTER_PLAN §3.2-3.3 and §4.7). One definition per capability, read by every module: the Survival Lab, the Homestead, the profiles, the scenarios and the facilities all refer to these ids. The 27 capabilities the wilderness engine has always had keep their ids and their evidence (wilderness/engine.py produces it); the eight new ones get theirs from the rules below (capability/records.py). Edit freely; capability/records.py and app/capability_pack.py rebuild everything that reads this.

water_supply.name: Water supply
water_supply.what: finding or making water fit to drink

cold_source.name: Cold source
cold_source.what: making cold: chilling, freezing, keeping things cold

heat_tolerance.name: Heat tolerance
heat_tolerance.what: working in heat: deserts, volcanoes, hot springs

light.name: Light
light.what: light in caves and at night

tracking.name: Tracking
tracking.what: following a scent or a trail

navigation.name: Navigation
navigation.what: finding the way over long distances

layers.A: Official game mechanics: field moves, overworld abilities, the games' own rules
layers.B: Natural biology: what the species could do, from its Pokédex text, body, type, size and habitat, or a move it knows put to use
layers.C: Equipment-assisted or trained: what it could do with a tool, a harness or training

mechanic.name: Game mechanic
mechanic.means: established by the game's rules or data

canon.name: Canon
canon.means: stated by an identifiable Pokémon source (its Pokédex text)

inferred.name: Inferred
inferred.means: reasoned from evidence: its Pokédex text, its body, type, size or habitat

hypothesis.name: Hypothesis
hypothesis.means: plausible, needs investigation: a move it knows put to use outside battle

creative.name: Blackthorn
creative.means: Blackthorn world-building, never canon (yours when approved)

standardized.name: Blackthorn standard
standardized.means: filled by a declared Blackthorn method

standing._note: How a member's best evidence for a capability reads. Never one overall score: every need shows its own standing and who holds it.

means.covered: a game mechanic it actually has (a field move it knows, an overworld ability it has) or a record you approved
means.equipped: a piece of kit you're bringing covers it, or a Pokémon can do it with kit you're bringing
means.teachable: a member can learn the field move but doesn't know it
means.plausible: its biology suggests it (Pokédex text, body, type, size, habitat) or a move it knows could be put to use; not a game mechanic and not yet your call
means.proposed: a Blackthorn record waiting for your approval, or kit it would need that isn't packed

shapes._note: The Gen 4 Pokédex's body shapes (PokeAPI pokemon_shapes). Only shapes that say something about what a body can do are used; wings aren't read as flight (Scizor's Pokédex: its wings aren't used for flying).

names.13: two or more pairs of wings

4: how fine its handling is varies; the shape doesn't say
6: it stands on two legs with its forelimbs free
how fine its handling is varies; the shape doesn't say
12: it stands on two legs with its forelimbs free
how fine its handling is varies; the shape doesn't say
10: it has tentacles or many limbs
8: a four-legged body that bears weight
only large or huge four-legged Pokémon count; speed and terrain limit it

types._note: Type readings for the new capabilities (the originals are in wilderness/engine.py _inference).
cold_source: its body is cold enough to chill what's around it

move_uses._note: A move a Pokémon knows, put to use outside battle (layer B, class hypothesis): counted only for a build that knows it. Field moves aren't here; they're game mechanics (layer A).

layer_c._note: Equipment-assisted and trained capabilities (layer C, class creative, proposed until you approve one). A Pokémon qualifies when its own evidence (not a move-use hypothesis) meets `requires`; it counts in a plan only when the kit holds the equipment.

rules.name: Pulls a cart or sled in a harness
rules.limitations: speed and terrain limit it; it needs rest stops

rules.name: Carries a rider in a saddle
rules.limitations: one rider; long days tire it

rules.name: Builds with hand tools
rules.limitations: fine work depends on its grip

rules.name: Tends crops with garden tools
rules.limitations: being a Grass type doesn't make it a gardener; it learns the work

rules.name: Trained search and rescue
rules.limitations: finds people; carrying them out needs a strong teammate

rules.name: Charges a storage battery
rules.limitations: its output isn't unlimited; it needs rest between charges

rules.name: Powers electric lamps
rules.limitations: only as long as it's rested and the battery holds

field_policy._note: The field-function policy (D-018, D-026-D-030) and the Blackthorn standard for a field move's slot cost. A field move earns its slot in battle if it's a damaging move of at least `battle_worthy_bp` power that generation, or one of `battle_worthy`; anything else costs a battle slot. That threshold is a Blackthorn standard, not a game rule: change it here.

platinum.Fly: D-029: Platinum has no Fly by design (city-based); Garchomp doesn't count as its flyer

field_policy.hm_slave: a member carrying two or more field moves that cost a battle slot (the policy says no HM slaves)

provisions._note: A Blackthorn standard for what to carry if nobody forages: rations a day by body size (the habitat engine's size class), the trainer's two, and water as much again. Not canon; change it here.
